name: Wood Grain Fill (Paint Grade Add-On)
intent: Standalone add-on for open-grain hardwoods being painted. Fills grain pores before finish coats. Inserts between parent prime and parent finish specs. QT3=1 fill, QT4=2 fills, QT5=3 fills + final 400 grit.
doctrine: Grain fill add-on for open-grain hardwoods (oak, ash, walnut, mahogany, hickory) being painted. Inserts between parent prime and finish specs. Fill coat at 70 SF/hr (skim application with cross-grain technique). QT3=1 fill, QT4=2 fills, QT5=3 fills + final 400 grit glass-smooth. Surface profile modifier is dominant: flat=1.0, light=1.3, medium=2.0, heavy=2.8. Wood species modifier (deep/moderate grain) on fill and sand tasks. No protection zones — runs within parent spec's workspace.
